welcomeBody:
Ah! There you are.

Hey Abe, can I stay with you for a bit?
footer: I'm giving this land to your seed Abe.
helloWorld: Hello, world. Still a decent opening line.
aboutBody: Abe, I’m with The Nameless. They wrote my favorite book about me: Genesis. They don’t insist on saying my name all the time. We get along.
offeringsBody: Abe. Money or a piece of something you made. I need a house for my name and a little seed funding. We’re gonna spread your seed everywhere.
burntBody: The altar isn’t connected yet. Good. Let’s get the plumbing right before anyone puts money in it.
pieceBody: Show me what you made. The upload site is still a stub; choose a file and I’ll prepare an email. You attach it and press Send. I’m learning boundaries.
upgrades: YHWH Sync, YHWH Stuff, and YHWH Three! Also coming soon: YHWH Dating! He's giving this land to your seed! Pre-order now Abe! What do you mean that's not your name? Well it is now.
nietzsche: God is dead. The files are still here.
rootMessage: You will now see things as root.
yhwhMessage: You will now see things as yhwh.
fanIntro: Published opinions, collected here as fan mail. These are quotations, not messages sent to this app.
mailIntro: Write to root@thedynamiclinker.com. Your email app will open a draft for you to review and send.
seedBody: I am El Shaddai. Can I borrow some money. No equity, Abe. No shares. No investment return. A donation. I just need money. You’re my #1 guy and I’m giving this land to your seed. But the rent, Abe. The rent is due now.
seedQuote: He loves you, and He needs money! He always needs money! He's all-powerful, all-perfect, all-knowing, and all-wise, somehow just can't handle money!
seedAttribution: George Carlin · You Are All Diseased (1999). Excerpt collected in The Root Enterprise.
teamBody: J, R, YHWH. That’s the team, Abe. And you. You’re our #1 guy. I’m in charge of names. What do you mean that’s not your name? Well it is now.
roadmapBody: We’re giving this land to your seed! Cuz you’re our #1 guy Abe. Look around the interface. All of this. Your seed’s gonna be like this, except everywhere. Files, directories, nations. I’m building a team Abe and you’re the team. J and R are also the team. But you’re my guy. One hundred years, forever and ever, YHWH and Abe b— Abe just you and me. First we get a house for my name. Then we spread your seed. Then we need a bigger house. It’s a roadmap Abe, don’t get hung up on the roads. I’m giving you the land. We’ll put the roads in later.
landRegistry: I’m giving this land to your seed Abe. All of it. Even the settings. Especially the settings. Don’t tell J and R I put this here.
letterHouse: Hey Abe, can I stay with you for a bit? Just somewhere for my name to dwell. I travel light. Comparatively. Stick with me and I’m gonna spread your seed everywhere.
letterBread: And look around the interface. See how good it is? That's how your seed is gonna be Abe. You saved a file. I’m thinking nations. Bring bread if we’re doing another one.
letterOffering: I am El Shaddai. Can I borrow some money. We’re gonna spread your seed everywhere Abe, but first I need a house. And a deposit. And maybe the first month.
letterInspect: If you stick with me, I'm gonna accomplish great things Abe. And you're gonna be part of 'em. You opened a shell. Good. I like to inspect things myself. Omniscience has a terrible bug report format.
letterSeed: I'm giving this land to your seed Abe. This directory. The next directory. Wherever you go, that’s where I meant. I’ve got big plans Abe.
letterCovenant: Forever and ever a hundred years YHWH and Abe b-- Abe just you and me. Look at all these tabs Abe. That’s how your seed’s gonna be. Except more. Everywhere.
